description: This file defines the ShipmentEvents class which contains static methods for handling shipment-related events within the OFBiz framework, including viewing shipment package route segment label images and checking/forcing shipment receipt status.

classes.name: ShipmentEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to handle shipment-related web events such as rendering shipment segment labels and updating shipment status.

methods.name: viewShipmentPackageRouteSegLabelImage
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to display the image label for a shipment package route segment, retrieves the label image from the database, and streams it to the browser.

methods.name: checkForceShipmentReceived
methods.description: Handles request to force mark a shipment as received by updating its status, based on request parameters.
